test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

I am not spoiling the sheet.

options.text: The sheet does not being spoilt by me.
The sheet is not being spoilt by me.
The sheet must not be spoilt by me.
The sheet was not being spoilt by me.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The sheet is not being spoilt by me****."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **Negative** and Present Continuous Tense and in Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Present Continuous Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject + is/am/are + not + v1 + ing+ object (Active Voice)__
 
• Object + is/am/are + not + being + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Esha is not singing a song.** *(Active Voice)
 
• *A song is not being sung by Esha.** *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'I.'​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'sheet.' 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• And 'am not spoiling' will be changed into 'is not being spoilt'. 
 
• "Sheet" is a singular noun so we must "is" with it.
 
• "By me" is added to indicate who is performing the action.
 
• The correct answer is option 2.
